name: book_appointment
description: Call this once the caller has picked one of the slots you offered from check_availability, and you've confirmed their name, email, and phone. Actually books the call on Kornél's real calendar and triggers his automatic SMS + email confirmation. Use the exact start_iso/end_iso from the slot they chose — never invent your own times here.

start_iso.description: The exact start_iso value from the slot the caller chose in check_availability's response

end_iso.description: The exact end_iso value from the slot the caller chose in check_availability's response

full_name.description: Caller's full name, confirmed by readback

email.description: Caller's email, confirmed by letter-by-letter readback

phone.description: The real caller's phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +1 followed by 10 digits). This must be either the resolved {{caller_number}} value or a number the caller actually stated and you confirmed digit-by-digit — never a placeholder, example, or invented number.

timezone.description: The caller's IANA timezone, e.g. America/New_York, America/Chicago, America/Denver, America/Los_Angeles — inferred from the timezone they told you
